summary: Iteration 22 full-stack testing: (1) Backend ClientCreate birth_date persistence (create/update/list), (2) Backend QR self-heal GET /api/channels/connections/{id}/qr, (3) FRONTEND modernized ClientForm with preview card + age chip + icons + auto-phone-format + disabled save validation + birth_date chip on expanded client card, (4) Conexoes page UI regression, (5) Regression on auth + core endpoints + 31 features. 10/10 backend pytest passed. Frontend UI flows all verified: login -> clientes shortcut -> add-client-btn -> modal with 6 testids -> phone auto-formatted (11) 98778-1527 -> age '40 anos' preview chip (1985-07-15) -> save enabled only when name>=2 AND phone>=10 digits -> on save: client appears in list, auto-expanded with '15/07/1985 · 40 anos' chip, inline booking form open. Conexoes page: tab Canais default, WhatsApp Boss card rendered with Conectar button.

minor.issue: birth_date is Optional[str] with no Pydantic validation; accepts any format like '1990/01/01'. Works as specified (frontend handles formatting) but consider validating YYYY-MM-DD on backend for consistency.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' -- dynamic tooling is injecting debug <span> into <option> elements via static-imported attributes; cosmetic warning only, does not affect functionality. Likely x-ve-dynamic instrumentation from build tooling, not application code.

critical_code_review_comments: channels_routes.get_connection_qr self-heal: when node_status is 'not_found' or 'disconnected' AND conn.status is waiting_qr/connecting AND no qr_base64, it POSTs /instances/{id}/connect but still returns the ORIGINAL data (qr=null). Frontend polling must retry — OK, but consider awaiting the connect for ~1s and re-fetching /qr in the same request for faster first-QR display.

scheduling_routes.update_client uses exclude_unset but then filters out None values (line 761: `if v is not None`). This means user CANNOT clear birth_date by sending birth_date=null; they'd have to omit field entirely (which exclude_unset already skips). Today this is fine (UI sends ''/date), but if UI adds a 'clear birth_date' action, update logic needs adjustment.
Dashboard.js is 3298 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting ClientForm, BookFromClientForm, ConnectionCard, TemplateEditor, EditAppointmentModal into /components/ files.

Minor React hydration warning: inside BookFromClientForm select options there's a <span data-ve-dynamic> injected by build tooling that makes <span> a child of <option>. Investigate if editor/debug tooling is the source; if yes, strip x-* attributes from <option> children in production build.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created+cleaned TEST_iter22_* clients via fixtures. UI test created TEST_iter22_UI_781527 client — cleaned up post-test via DELETE /api/scheduling/clients/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 validates: (a) ClientCreate model adds birth_date Optional[str], persisted in create/update/list; (b) QR self-heal triggers POST /connect when Node has no instance; (c) Modernized ClientForm with icons (User/Phone/Calendar/Mail), phone mask '(99) 99999-9999', live preview card (avatar+name+phone+age), client-validation disable save<2chars name or <10digit phone; (d) Client expansion shows birth_date chip + age + optional 🎂 anniversary chip if within 30 days; (e) Conexoes page Canais tab + ConnectionCard (pollingAttempts=4 triggers retry-connect-{id}). Boss company slug='boss'. Only 1 WhatsApp conn ('WhatsApp Boss') — do not create more in prod preview.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Both user-reported issues (QR polling infinite loop + add birth_date to client) have been resolved in this iteration.
